item.title: UIC falls one win short of first NCAA Tournament berth in 22 years, as UNI wins MVC title
item.description: Trey Campbell hit six 3-pointers in scoring 23 points and Northern Iowa defeated UIC 84-69 to win the Missouri Valley Conference Tournament and an automatic NCAA bid on Sunday.The Panthers (23-12) won the tournament for the sixth time and earned their ninth NCAA appearance and first since 2016.
